text.description_html:
Laurey Polished Chrome Modern Cabinet Pull

The Modern Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull has an interesting and sleek design great for adding a contemporary touch to any kitchen cabinet. This Polished Chrome Modern Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware. Its strong lines are made bolder by the Polished Chrome finish.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Contempo Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • C/C Length: 3-3/4"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 3/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Contempo Collection.
